issues.description: In the template, the fields `lectureName` and `numberOfInscribedStudents` are declared as `public`, but the problem statement UML marks all Lecture attributes as private ("-") and the reference solution declares these fields as `private`. This conflicts with the intended encapsulation and can confuse students about whether to access fields directly or via getters/setters.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to match the UML/solution by changing the predeclared fields to private (or remove them and let students add all attributes): `private String lectureName; private int numberOfInscribedStudents;`.
